poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Debuff duration. Take 10 damage at the start of each tick after Instant spells, then lose 1 duration. New applications add duration.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Buff duration. Heal 10 at the start of each tick after Instant spells, then lose 1 duration. New applications add duration.

ward.name: Ward
ward.description: Absorbs direct damage before Health; excess damage hits Health. Damage over time bypasses Ward. Does not stack: gaining Ward keeps the higher of your current Ward and the new amount. Does not decay.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Cancels the current enemy spell, even a 1T spell finishing this tick. Also skips the remaining copies in its current Channel group (up to 3). Simultaneous interrupts cancel each other.

empowered.name: Empowered
empowered.description: An enhanced spell: +50% direct damage, healing and Ward. This is separate from critical hits and does not consume Heat.

heat.name: Heat
heat.description: Counter. Starting your next non-Instant spell with at least 5 Heat consumes 5 and makes its cast time exactly 1T, including through Slow. Extra charges remain.

oath.name: Oath
oath.description: A timed condition beginning on the next full tick. Complete it to receive its printed reward. Damage conditions count Health damage after protection; dealing damage includes Poison and your Imp. Only one Oath can be active: a new one replaces the previous one. Reshuffling or interruption does not cancel it.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Debuff duration. Each non-Instant spell started while Slow is active takes +1T. Slow is not consumed on cast; loses 1 duration each following tick. Existing casts are unchanged.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Remove the printed number of unique debuffs from yourself, or all if unspecified. Priority: Poison, Slow, Trap, Weaken, Frailty, Repetition, Curse, Stun.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Resolve a spell’s effects again without advancing the sequence. A repeat does not count as another spell for Oaths or augment counters.

consume.name: Consume
consume.description: Remove the named duration or charges and use the amount removed for the payoff.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Link up to 3 matching spells in adjacent slots. Each extra copy adds the Channel bonus to every spell in the group. Interrupt cancels the remaining group.

unique.name: Unique
unique.description: Only one copy may be held. Matching shop copies can still upgrade it.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: One pass through your sequence, followed by one reshuffle tick.

frailty.name: Frailty
frailty.description: Affliction attunement required to gain or apply this keyword. Duration. Take 20% more incoming enemy damage. Loses 1 duration at the end of each following tick.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Debuff counter. Take 10 damage per stack when your next cycle begins, after reshuffling. Stacks persist until cleansed.

attunement.name: Attunement
attunement.description: Your two most numerous domains are attuned. Ties favor the oldest card still held. Only effects explicitly marked with a domain attunement requirement need that domain; unmarked effects remain usable.

instant.name: Instant
instant.description: Resolves before other effects that tick, including over-time effects and ordinary spells. Simultaneous Instant spells resolve together.

trap.name: Trap
trap.description: Debuff duration. Each completed spell deals 10 damage to its caster. Echoes do not count as additional casts. Loses 1 duration each following tick.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.description: Debuff duration. Deal 20% less damage. Loses 1 duration each following tick.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Buff duration. Prevents all damage, including periodic and self-inflicted damage, while active. Explicit Health loss costs bypass it. Loses 1 duration each following tick.

resilience.name: Resilience
resilience.description: Buff duration. Take 50% less damage. Loses 1 duration each following tick unless granted for the rest of combat. Explicit Health costs bypass it.

tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
tidecaller.description: Counter. At 5 charges, starting the next spell consumes 5 and gives it one Echo at 50% effectiveness. Extra charges remain. Interrupted spells lose their reserved Echo.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Resolve the spell’s effects again at the stated effectiveness (normally 50%). Echoes do not trigger another Echo or another cast. Whole-number amounts round to the nearest integer.

potency.name: Potency
potency.description: Counter. Each charge adds 10 percentage points of critical-hit chance, capped at 100%. Charges persist. Critical rolls are seeded for repeatable replays.

critical.name: Critical
critical.description: A critical spell deals 150% damage by default. Eruption can change this to 200% or 250%. Echoes share the original spell’s critical result.

fury.name: Fury
fury.description: Buff duration. Deal 10% more damage. Loses 1 duration each following tick.

cultivate.name: Cultivate
cultivate.description: Consume the specified over-time effect to resolve the printed payoff immediately.

poisonPower.name: Venom Bloom
poisonPower.description: Your Poison damage multiplier for this combat. Recasting keeps the strongest multiplier, without stacking.

regenerationPower.name: Flourish
regenerationPower.description: Your Regeneration healing multiplier until the next Cycle begins.

nextDamage.name: Astral Alignment
nextDamage.description: Your next completed spell’s direct damage multiplier. Consumed even if that spell deals no damage.

nextEcho.name: Tidal Power
nextEcho.description: Effectiveness of your next Tidecaller Echo. Consumed when five Tidecaller charges are reserved at cast start.

critDamage.name: Eruption
critDamage.description: Your critical-hit damage multiplier for this combat. Recasting keeps the strongest multiplier.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Put the named effect on the enemy. Applying Regeneration heals the enemy.

gain.name: Gain
gain.description: Put the named effect on yourself.

stun.name: Stun
stun.description: Pauses casting and rotation, including reshuffling, for its duration. Over-time effects and other durations still tick.

summon.name: Summon
summon.description: At the end of the tick, summon or revive an Imp with the printed Health. If still alive, add to its current and maximum Health. It absorbs direct enemy damage; overflow hits you. Applied effects and damage over time still hit you. Empowered Imp attacks after each spell you complete.

doom.name: Doom
doom.description: Debuff counter reserved for a future spell. Its trigger and damage are not defined yet; no current spell applies it.

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.description: After its first completed cast, this copy breaks and leaves the rotation for the rest of the duel. It returns next duel. Interrupting it does not break it. Echoes on that first cast still resolve.

unholy.name: Unholy
unholy.description: Your healing becomes damage to the enemy for the duration, including Regeneration. Printed healing converts even at full Health; heal-to-full converts only missing Health. Enemy healing stays unchanged.
